name: WP Speed Core
changelog:
v1.6.8:
- Synthetic Audit Protection: guardrail against artificial 7s LCP/TTI inflation on Lighthouse/PageSpeed by preventing fallback timer during bot audits.
- Auto-Delay Tracking & Third-Party Engine: auto-queue heavy tracking scripts (GTM, taggateway, Full Picture, Microsoft Clarity, RecordRTC) into delayed execution to eliminate 600ms+ mobile CPU main-thread blocking.
- Clean Default Exclusions: strip legacy tracking keywords (gtag, analytics) from delay exclusion list so tracking scripts execute safely on first user interaction without blocking initial render.
- Dynamic Script Onload Restoration: guarantee third-party onload callbacks (like FP.loaded) fire reliably upon user interaction execution.
